svg.aria-label: Kernel slack against the clock for the 43 U50 builds the ledger states a kernel slack for, and the slack of the images built at 130 and 135 MHz in build order. One tile closes 175 MHz; four tiles close 135.
svg.title: Kernel slack against the clock for the 43 U50 builds the ledger states a kernel slack for, and the slack of the images built at 130 and 135 MHz in build order. One tile closes 175 MHz; four tiles close 135.
svg.text: How far the clock was pushed, and what it left in slack
The slack of the kernel's worst path for every U50 build the ledger states it for, read out of docs/VALIDATION.md; a
scan of the ledger, repeated on every check, holds that none is missing (the rule is in the sidecar). A build closes
timing when its slack is not negative. Left: slack against the clock it was built at. Right: the images built at 130
and 135 MHz, in the order they were built.
slack (ns) against the clock built for (MHz)
slack of every 130 and 135 MHz image, in build order
Missed, of 43 builds with a stated kernel slack: one tile at 260 MHz, -3.163 (31 Aug); one tile at 150 MHz, -0.070 (1 Sep); four tiles at
145 MHz, -0.302 (1 Sep); four tiles at 135 MHz, -0.363 (16 Sep); one tile at 175 MHz, -0.102 (24 Sep). Every other one closed. The sweep's
closed points (145, 150, 155, 160, 165, 170, 175 MHz) passed the conformance set on the card at 7 of 7; the quad closed 135 MHz 10 times
with slack from +0.003 to +0.143 ns. Not drawn, because the ledger states only the whole design's slack for them: one tile at 135 MHz, 1
Sep, -0.577 ns; four tiles at 135 MHz, 2 Sep, -0.141 ns; four tiles at 135 MHz, 2 Sep, -0.113 ns.
